about: {name} is an online store for newborn, baby and kids' products: toys, games, clothes, footwear, diapers and strollers.
description: {name} case study: a custom-built Shopify store for newborn, baby and kids' products, with category pages, product pages, a cart and GoKwik checkout.
kind: Online store, newborn, baby and kids' products
brief: {name} sells newborn, baby and kids' products online, from toys and games to clothes, footwear, diapers and strollers. The vision was a premium kids' shop where international products for children are available in India, covering everything the store sells today.

The expectation was practical: a working website with categories, product pages and listings. We custom-built the store on Shopify, kept apps and tools to a minimum, used Shopify's native features wherever they existed, and connected GoKwik for checkout.

showcases.title: A homepage that opens on the range
showcases.text: Shop by age, category and brand sit in the main menu, with round category tiles straight under the banner. On a phone the menu folds behind one button.

showcases.title: Listings that work like a shop shelf
showcases.text: Each collection opens with a short description, then filters for availability and price, a sort control and product cards with brand, price and add to cart. The Games collection is shown.

showcases.title: Delivery and payment answered before add to cart
showcases.text: A gallery, the price inclusive of taxes, the free delivery threshold, UPI, card and cash on delivery, then add to cart and buy it now. Returns and support sit just below.

showcases.title: A Shopify cart with GoKwik checkout
showcases.text: The cart shows the offers on hand and one checkout button. Checkout opens GoKwik's flow, which starts with a mobile number.

showcases.title: Social creative tiles
showcases.text: Two portrait tiles in the store's lilac palette, made as campaign artwork.

showcases.title: A Meta ad and a Google search ad
showcases.text: Campaign artwork in the same palette as the store, so an ad and the page it points to read as one brand.

flow.site: Homepage, category listings, product pages and cart on Shopify, with checkout by GoKwik
flow.reach: Meta ad and Google search ad
flow.make: Social creative tiles and ad artwork

results.lead: A fast store that turns visits into orders.
results.note: PageSpeed scores are for the homepage.
